description: RESELLER (partner token): mint a short-lived, single-origin co-branded embed session for a sourced project — the returned embedPath renders inside YOUR product ("Powered by OpenTrain"); frame-ancestors is pinned to the origin. Cookie-free. Requires OPENTRAIN_PARTNER_TOKEN with embed:sessions.

origin.description: Bare https origin that will frame the embed, e.g. https://app.partner.example

name: opentrain_partner_create_embed_session
